post.description: Read the current revision of a Wikipedia (or sister-project) article by exact title: full wikitext (or HTML with body), abstract, categories, redirects, connected Wikidata QID, license, and revision credibility signals. Use structured-contents instead when you want infobox fields, sections or references already parsed. From https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Berlin pass name `Berlin` and project `dewiki`. Not a search: titles must match exactly.

name.description: Exact article title as on the wiki, for example `Marie_Curie` or `Marie Curie`. Case-sensitive: Wikipedia titles start with a capital letter. From a URL such as https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marie_Curie, use the part after /wiki/.

project.description: Wikimedia project identifier: language code plus project code, for example `enwiki` (English Wikipedia), `frwiki`, `dewiki`, `enwiktionary` or `eswikivoyage`. Defaults to `enwiki` when neither project nor language is given. `reference/projects` lists every identifier.

language.description: Wikimedia language code, for example `en`, `fr` or `zh-yue`. Returns the article from any project in that language; combine with project to pin one wiki.

fields.description:
Return only these fields, in dot notation, for example `name`, `abstract`, `url`, `version.identifier`. Omit for the full record. Wikimedia returns exactly the fields named.

Provider reference: maximum 50.

limit.description:
Most matching articles to return, 1 to 10. More than one only helps when no project is pinned and the title exists on several wikis.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 10; default 1.

body.description:
Which article_body format to include when fields is not given: `wikitext` (default, compact), `html` (MediaWiki DOM, often 5-10x larger), `both`, or `none` for metadata and abstract only.

Provider reference: allowed values ["wikitext", "html", "both", "none"]; default "wikitext".

200.description:
Articles matching the exact title in the selected project or language, newest revision each. article_body carries the format chosen with body, wikitext by default. Empty when none match. Priced per article returned.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| `namespace` | object | MediaWiki namespace; 0 is the main article namespace. |

| `additional_entities` | object[] | Other Wikidata entities used on the page. |

post.description: Read a Wikipedia article pre-parsed into JSON: one-line description, abstract, infobox fields, sections as paragraphs and lists with links, references and tables. Best for extracting facts such as a person's birth date or a city's population without parsing HTML. Beta upstream, with the most complete coverage on en, de, fr, es, pt, it, nl, cy and id Wikipedia. Exact title, as for articles/lookup.

Provider reference: maximum 50.

post.description: Read a Wikidata item by QID: labels, descriptions and aliases in every language, all statements (property values with qualifiers and references) and links to its article on each wiki. Use for structured facts such as dates, identifiers and relationships, or to find an entity's article title in another language through sitelinks. Beta upstream; a very large item can fail.

identifier.description: Wikidata item ID (QID), for example `Q42`. An article's main_entity.identifier is its QID.

fields.description:
Return only these fields, in dot notation, for example `entity.labels.en` or `entity.statements.P569`. Omit for the full record.

Provider reference: maximum 50.

200.description:
One Wikidata item, latest revision. Entity data is CC0.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | The entity identifier, for example Q42. |
| `url` | string | Entity page on wikidata.org. |
| `date_modified` | string |  |
| `entity` | object | The entity: identifier, type (item or property), labels, descriptions and aliases keyed by language code, statements keyed by property ID (values, qualifiers, references) and sitelinks keyed by project, for example sitelinks.enwiki.title. |
| `version` | object | Revision of the entity page. |
| `license` | object[] | CC0 for Wikidata entity data. |
